name: docx_replace
description: Find and replace text in a Word .docx file, keeping its formatting. Matches text even when it is split over formatting runs. Body text only (not headers or footers).

find.description: text to find (one line, case sensitive)

first_only.description: replace only the first match (default: all)

output.description: write the result here instead of changing the file; must not exist

edge_cases: no match leaves the file untouched
